title: Flues.
officialText:
Separate flues and independent combustion air source shall be provided for every fireplace stove and room heater.
Combustion air shall be provided in accordance with the manufacturer’s recommendations and Chapter 7.
SECTION MC 906
FACTORY-BUILT BARBECUE APPLIANCES
